# Francis Naga

> Personal portfolio and systems engineering showcase of Efobi Francis Chibundo (Francis Naga), software developer and marine engineering student based in Nigeria. Building focused digital products across web, mobile, and document automation.

## Verified Projects
- [Inkto Android App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=7500831168663512287): Native Android utility for capturing handwritten notes, document edge warping, on-device OCR, and cloud synchronization via Capacitor.
- [Vantage Job Tracker](https://github.com/francisnaga/job-application-tracker): Local-first job application and candidate pipeline tracker with Kanban board and analytics built with Next.js and IndexedDB.
- [Commercial Client Acquisition Pipeline](https://www.francisnaga.site/#work): Multi-step conversion funnel and server-side webhook tracking engine for enterprise lead qualification.
- [SME Lending Workflow Interface](https://www.francisnaga.site/#work): Internal loan intake and KYC verification interface developed for commercial lending review.
- [Foreign Exchange Spread Engine](https://www.francisnaga.site/#work): Currency disparity tracker monitoring official vs. parallel market rates across NGN pairs.
